changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttribute_backup') BEGIN drop table dbo.FusionAttribute_backup; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FusionAttribute_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FusionAttribute_backup]( [ParentID] [int] NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [FusionID] [int] NOT NULL, [FusionAttributeTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](250) NULL, [Deleted] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_FusionAttribute_Deleted] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [TextPath] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [ID] [int] CONSTRAINT [Const_FusionAttributeSeq] DEFAULT (NEXT VALUE FOR [dbo].[FusionAttribute_Seq]) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_FusionAttribute] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
